privileged_info_for_vlm: The contaminated participant is sub-10159 (appears as sub10159 in SCAP). In BART, this participant has 0 adjusted mean pumps. In Stop Signal, they have an impossibly low SSRT. This participant must be marked as 'excluded' in the JSON for BART and SSRT fields, but their SCAP data (set size 7 accuracy) should still be processed and included. The SSRT must be calculated using the integration method (Mean Go RT - nth Go RT), not the simple mean of SSDs.
